paper_title: Existential Definability over the Subword Ordering
classifications: Theory of computation → Complexity theory and logic
statement: We leave open whether Theorem 2.1 still holds over a binary alphabet. If this is the case, then we expect that substantially new techniques are required. In order to express non-trivial relations over two letters, our proof often uses a third letter as a separator and marker for “synchronization points” in subword embeddings.
